description: Two sections each with their own scale and offset knobs, in 2HP, where the B output carries an averaged mix of both when the A output is left unpatched

params.text: Scales that section's signal, -1x fully counter-clockwise through 0x in the centre to +1x fully clockwise, and further under the menu's scale range
Offsets that section's signal, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and with nothing patched in this knob alone sets the output voltage

inputs.text: The signal for the A section, scaled and offset by the A knobs
The signal for the B section; with the jack empty it reads the A input instead, so one signal can be processed two ways at once

outputs.text: Carries the A input scaled and offset, with as many channels as that input has
Carries the B input scaled and offset; with the A output left unpatched it carries the two sections added and halved instead, and a small green light beside it shows when it does

notes: mixing needs an input in both sections and the A output empty; a green light beside the B output shows when a mix is coming out of it
with the B section linked to the A section on the menu, the B knobs grey out and follow the A knobs, and a small red mark near the B input shows the link
menu: Set A-offset (semitone steps) — sets the A offset knob to a whole number of semitones between -11 and +11
Set B-offset (semitone steps) — sets the B offset knob to a whole number of semitones between -11 and +11
Scale-range mode: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x — widens what the scale knobs cover, 1x meaning -100% to +100%; a light beside the Scale label is dark at 1x, green at 2x, yellow at 5x and red at 10x
Scale-mode: Exp, Linear, Log — bends the response of the scale knobs; the small light beside the Scale label is dark for Linear, green for Exp and red for Log
Operation-order: Scale->Offset, Offset->Scale — chooses whether the input is scaled and then offset, or offset and then scaled; the blue light beside the Offset label is lit for the second
B-section mode: Individual, Linked to A-section — links the B scale and offset knobs to the A knobs, greying the B pair out
Mix-mode (mix unplugged outputs) — turned off, each output carries only its own section, so an unpatched output no longer feeds its signal down to the next one
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed

inputs.1:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A input.
